readme_summary: elizaOS Your agentic operating system. Eliza · Eliza Cloud · elizaOS downloads · Documentation elizaOS is an open-source TypeScript framework and product stack for autonomous AI agents. This monorepo contains the core runtime, the Eliza app, the CLI, cloud services, native bridges, and first-party plugins. Linux and Android distribution tooling lives in `packages/os`. The repository pins Bun and Node versions in `package.json`. Install those versions, then: `bun install` also prepares submodules and patches, provisions supported host build prerequisites, and builds or verifies the staged desktop `libelizainference`. The embedding GGUF remains runtime-managed and downloads automatically during local-inference warmup. Fetch archived artifact fixtures explicitly with `bun packages/scripts/fetch-archive-artifacts.ts` when needed.
install_commands: bun run start       # run the standalone agent host
bun run build       # build the workspace with Turbo
bun run verify      # dependency, type, lint, and audit gates
bun run test        # repository unit/integration test lane
bun run cloud:mock  # local Eliza Cloud stack with mocks
